title: Establish reproducible decision-context evaluations
description:
## Scope

Measure whether selected labeled context improves agreement with ground-truth labels across context budgets, datasets, and Jev, Kev, and Laya. Preserve the Few-Shot-Jev study as historical experimental notes. Start with Jev selection and ordering studies before making cross-model claims.

## Definition of done

Pinned dataset manifests; frozen study plans; resumable collection; reproducible offline reports; complete accounting of eligible and excluded conditions. Each live study has an explicit request ceiling and collection approval.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-e9e02429-a60a-4747-adb3-93cab7ec4314`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

The large static Jev selection-by-size study is complete and published: `studies/INITIAL_JEV_RESULTS.md` (commits 44e14e1, 7068ded). Demonstration-ordering and Jev/Kev/Laya cross-model comparisons are **deferred, not cancelled** (Laya and Kev cannot take few-shot context). No spend is approved for this work.

Reconciled today: dataset, collection/reporting infrastructure, selector-by-size preregistration and the initial study are closed with evidence; ordering, cross-model rules, the model matrix and the Kev/Laya pilot half are in backlog; reporting keeps one open replay item. Active work is in the new initiative above (Phase 1 to Phase 3 epics). Lowered to low priority.
